Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=CUSTOMIZATION_IM
AGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^min_height
request_body_param.desc: The minimum required height, in pixels, for an image uploaded by the consumer.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^min_width
request_body_param.desc: The minimum required width, in pixels, for an image uploaded by the consumer.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^is_required
request_body_param.desc: Specifies whether the consumer must provide customization content for this area. If set to `false`, the default content or base product version may be used.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^text_area
request_body_param.desc: Configuration for a text-type customization area. This field should be provided when `area_type` is `TEXT`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^align_type
request_body_param.desc: The text alignment type. Enum values: `LEFT`, `CENTER`, `RIGHT`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^colors
request_body_param.desc: A list of text colors available for consumers to choose from, using hexadecimal color values such as `#FFFFFF`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^default_text
request_body_param.desc: Optional default text displayed in this area. If the consumer does not customize this area, the default text may be used.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^fonts
request_body_param.desc: A list of font keys available for consumers to choose from, based on the platform-supported font library.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^^max_text_length
request_body_param.desc: The maximum number of characters allowed for consumer text input.

request_body_param.name: ^^^external_surface_id
request_body_param.desc: The seller-defined external identifier of the customizable surface, used for mapping with the seller's own system.

request_body_param.name: ^^^mask_image
request_body_param.desc: An optional mask image placed above the customization areas to support irregular or cut-out effects.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the mask image.
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=CUSTOMIZATION_IM
AGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^surface_name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the customizable surface, for example, `Front Side` or `Back Side`.

request_body_param.name: ^^template_name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the customization template, used by the seller for internal management.

request_body_param.name: product_attributes
request_body_param.desc:
A list of general attributes (e.g. manufacturer, country of origin, materials used) that describe the product as a whole, regardless of variant. 

**Important**: The attributes available for use are determined by the system based on the product's assigned category, with some being mandatory. You must provide the product attributes marked as `is_required` in the response of the [Get Attributes API](6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8) to avoid listing failure.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc: The ID of the product attribute, retrieved from the [Get Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8).

request_body_param.name: ^values
request_body_param.desc:
A list of selectable values for the product attribute.

**Note**: Provide either a built-in ID or a custom name; if both are provided, the ID takes priority.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the product attribute value.
This is either a built-in product attribute value ID from [Get Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8) or a custom product attribute value ID returned after calling [Create Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6502fc8da57708028b42b18a).

request_body_param.name: ^^name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom product attribute value if the existing values do not satisfy your needs. The system will auto-generate an ID after editing.

**Note**:
- No duplicates allowed under the same attribute.
- Max length: 2000 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^^metric_standard_info
request_body_param.desc: Defines the measurement template information used to describe the measurement standards and metric values configured for the product.

request_body_param.name: ^^^id
request_body_param.desc: The unique ID of the measurement template. Use this ID to identify which measurement standard template applies to the product.

request_body_param.name: ^^^metric_value_module_infos
request_body_param.desc: The list of metric value entries under the measurement template. Each object represents the value submitted by the seller for a specific metric in the template.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^id
request_body_param.desc: The unique ID of a metric item within the measurement template. This ID identifies which metric the submitted value belongs to.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^value
request_body_param.desc: The seller-provided value for the specified metric item in the measurement template.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^unit_id
request_body_param.desc: Metric value module unit id.

request_body_param.name: replicated_products
request_body_param.desc:
The list of local market replicas to which updates should be synced. As this is a partial edit endpoint, only updated fields will be synced.
**Compulsory sync**
- **Sales attribute changes** (in sales attribute id/name) must be synced to other markets. Therefore, you must provide the `seller_sku` above and complete the details in this object. The API call will fail if you don't provide these details.
**Optional sync**
- **New SKUs* (new sales attribute value id/name) are optional to sync to other markets. To sync, please provide the `seller_sku` above and complete the details in this object.
- **General changes** are optional to sync to other markets. To sync, you only need to provide `replicated_products.region`.

request_body_param.name: ^inventory_mode
request_body_param.desc:
Defines the inventory mode for the duplicated target product. This parameter supports two modes: SHARED and EXCLUSIVE.
 
- SHARED: In this mode, the inventory of all interconnected (shared) products must be strictly consistent; otherwise, an error will be returned.
- EXCLUSIVE: In this mode, the inventory for each product can be set independently without affecting others.
 
Applicability:
This feature is applicable ONLY for the EU market.
 
Default Value:
If left empty, the system defaults to the EXCLUSIVE mode.

request_body_param.name: ^region
request_body_param.desc:
The market where you want to publish the global product.Possible values:
- AT: Austria
- BE:Belgium
- CZ:Czech Republic
- DE: Germany
- ES: Spain
- FR: France
- GB: United Kingdom
- GR: Greece
- HU:Hungary
- ID: Indonesia
- IE: Ireland
- IT: Italy
- JP: Japan
- MY: Malaysia
- NL: Netherlands(NL)
- PH: Philippines
- PO: Poland
- PT:Portugal
- SG: Singapore
- TH: Thailand
- US: United States
- VN: Vietnam
- MX: Mexico

request_body_param.name: ^skus
request_body_param.desc:
The SKUs to be synced to the specified market.
Specify this **only if** you are adding SKUs or changing the sales attribute id/name.
**Note**:
- You must pass in all existing SKUs. Any existing SKU IDs not listed here will result in the deletion of those SKUs. For example, if this product contains 5 SKUs and you only provide 2 SKU IDs, the remaining 3 will be deleted.
- To create new SKUs, leave the SKU ID blank and provide the seller_sku.

request_body_param.name: ^^external_sku_id
request_body_param.desc:
An external identifier used in an external ecommerce platform. This is used to associate the SKU between TikTok Shop and the external ecommerce platform. 
Max length: 999 characters

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc: The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop. Provide this for existing SKUs

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory
request_body_param.desc: SKU inventory information per warehouse. This field is mandatory for other regions. But when syncing products from the US to MX, the MX product inventory field is optional.

request_body_param.name: ^^^quantity
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU quantity available in the warehouse.
Valid range: [1, 999,999]. This field is mandatory for other regions. But when syncing products from the US to MX, the MX product inventory field is optional.

request_body_param.name: ^^^warehouse_id
request_body_param.desc: The warehouse ID. Retrieve this value from the [Get Warehouse List API](650aa418defece02be6e66b6) or Get Inventory Rules API. This field is mandatory for other regions. But when syncing products from the US to MX, the MX product inventory field is optional.

request_body_param.name: ^^price
request_body_param.desc: The SKU's **local display price** shown on the product page before any discounts

request_body_param.name: ^^^currency
request_body_param.desc:
The currency.
Possible values based on the region:
- BRL: Brazil
- CZK: Czech Republic
- EUR: France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Greece, Portugal
- GBP: United Kingdom
- HUF: Hungary
- IDR: Indonesia
- JPY: Japan
- MXN: Mexico
- MYR: Malaysia
- PHP: Philippines
- PLN: Poland
- SGD: Singapore
- THB: Thailand
- USD: United States
- VND: Vietnam

request_body_param.name: ^^^sale_price
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU's local display price shown on the product page before any discounts. 
Refer to Product Pricing for the allowed price ranges in each market.

request_body_param.name: ^^seller_sku
request_body_param.desc:
The seller_sku value of the source product above.
- Valid length: 1-50 characters
- Format: Text without spaces

request_body_param.name: responsible_person_ids
request_body_param.desc:
A comma-delimited list of responsible person IDs. Retrieve the IDs from the [Search Responsible Persons API](67066a55f17b7d02f95d2fb1).

**Note**: Applicable only for the EU market in certain categories. Use the [Get Category Rules API](6509c0febace3e02b74594a9) to check the requirements.

request_body_param.name: save_mode
request_body_param.desc:
Indicates how the product should be saved.
Possible values:
- AS_DRAFT: Save the product as a draft for future editing.
- LISTING: Immediately list the product in the shop.
Default: LISTING

**Note**: 
- Saving as draft is not supported in the following cases:
  - The product status is `DELETED`.
  - The product status is `PENDING` or `FREEZE` on any listing platform.
- If you are saving a post-live draft with `save_mode=AS_DRAFT`, `inventory` and `delivery_option_ids` fields are **not supported** and will not be saved.

request_body_param.name: scheduled_sale
request_body_param.desc: Scheduled listing configuration for the product, including whether scheduled listing is enabled and the scheduled listing time.

request_body_param.name: ^is_enabled_scheduled_sale
request_body_param.desc: Whether scheduled listing is enabled for this product. If true, scheduled_sale_time must be provided.

request_body_param.name: ^schedule_sale_time
request_body_param.desc: Scheduled listing time, expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds; must be later than the current time and within 90 days, and is required when is_enabled_scheduled_sale is true.

request_body_param.name: search_terms
request_body_param.desc: Search terms (ST words). ST words will not be displayed to consumers; they are only used in search engines to increase your search weight and gain more traffic. Please ensure that ST words are consistent with the product description, with a maximum of 15 terms and a total of no more than 250 characters.

request_body_param.name: size_chart
request_body_param.desc:
The measurement details of the product to help buyers find the right size.

**Note**: 
- For certain product categories, size charts may be required or not supported. Use the [Get Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c0febace3e02b74594a9) to check the requirements.
-  If size charts are not supported, even if you provide a size chart here, the size chart will not be saved.
- Provide either a TikTok Shop size chart template ID or a size chart image; if both are provided, the ID takes priority.

request_body_param.name: ^image
request_body_param.desc:
An image of the size chart.

**Recommendations**:
- Resolution: Minimum 1024px on the shorter side
- Content: Include key measurement dimensions (e.g., bust, waist, hips, inseam), the more the better.
- Format: Use a table with distinct columns and row.
  - Use only one table per product and image.
  - Display each dimension in a separate row.
  - Display units in column headers.

request_body_param.name: ^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the size chart image.
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=SIZE_CHART_IMAGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^template
request_body_param.desc: A TikTok Shop size chart template generated by the size chart tool in Seller Center > Manage Products > Bulk action > Batch manage size charts.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc: The size chart template ID.

request_body_param.name: skus
request_body_param.desc:
A list of Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) used to identify distinct variants of the product.

**Note**:
- Max SKUs for BR, EU, JP, MX, UK, US: 300
- Max SKUs for other regions: 100

**Recommendations**: Place the most important variant at the beginning of the array.

request_body_param.name: ^external_list_prices
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU list price (e.g. MSRP, RRP) or original price information on external ecommerce platforms.
Applicable only for selected sellers in the US market.

**Note**: This value may appear as the strikethrough price on the product page. However, whether the strikethrough price is shown and the amount shown are subject to the audit team's review and decision based on various pricing information.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
The price amount.
Valid range: [0.01, 7600]

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc:
The currency.
Possible values: USD

request_body_param.name: ^^source
request_body_param.desc:
The external ecommerce platform from which the price is sourced.
Possible values:
- SHOPIFY_COMPARE_AT_PRICE: The compare_at_price in Shopify.

request_body_param.name: ^external_sku_id
request_body_param.desc:
An external identifier used in an external ecommerce platform. This is used to associate the SKU between TikTok Shop and the external ecommerce platform. 
Max length: 999 characters

request_body_param.name: ^external_urls
request_body_param.desc:
A comma-delimited list of URLs for third-party product listing pages where consumers can place orders. Add this property if you have products listed on third-party sites other than TikTok Shop and would like to map them.
Max string length: 500

request_body_param.name: ^extra_identifier_codes
request_body_param.desc:
If the SKU belongs to a virtual bundle (containing multiple individual SKUs), you can add up to 10 additional identifier codes here for the SKUs included in the bundle.

**Format**:
GTIN: 14 digits 
EAN: 8, 13, or 14 digits 
UPC: 12 digits 
ISBN: 13 digits, or 9 digits ending in capital `X`

**Note**: 
- Applicable only for the EU market. 
- The identifier code must be unique for each SKU, with no repetition allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^fees
request_body_param.desc: The fees required for this product based on TikTok Shop policies. Fees are required only for certain product categories, retrieve the requirements from the [Get Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c0febace3e02b74594a9).

request_body_param.name: ^^additional_attribute
request_body_param.desc:
An optional attribute that provides additional context for the fee. The accepted values may vary by fee type and market.

Possible values for Pfand:
- SINGLE_USE
- REUSABLE
- NOT_APPLICABLE

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
The fee amount.
Valid range:
- PFAND: [0.00 - 6300.00]

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of fee.
Possible values: PFAND

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop. One product can contain multiple SKU IDs.

**Note**: 
- To edit an existing SKU, include its SKU ID.
- Any existing SKU IDs not listed here will result in the deletion of those SKUs. For example, if this product contains 5 SKUs and you only provide 2 SKU IDs, the remaining 3 will be deleted.
- To create new SKUs, leave the SKU ID blank and complete the other fields.

request_body_param.name: ^identifier_code
request_body_param.desc:
A regulated identifier code assigned to a product based on international standardized regulations (e.g. GTIN) to ensure the product is universally identifiable across various platforms and systems.

**Note**: Editable only if the product is in DRAFT state. Otherwise, changes are not allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^^code
request_body_param.desc:
The identifier code.

**Format**:
- GTIN: 14 digits 
- EAN: 8, 13, or 14 digits 
- UPC: 12 digits 
- ISBN: 13 digits, or 9 digits ending in capital `X`
- JAN: 8 or 13 digits
**Note**: The identifier code must be unique for each SKU, with no repetition allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of identifier code.
Possible values:
- GTIN
- EAN
- UPC
- ISBN
- JAN

request_body_param.name: ^inventory
request_body_param.desc:
SKU inventory information.
**Note**: If you are saving a post-live draft with `save_mode=AS_DRAFT`, this field is not supported and will not be saved. When using Get Product to retrieve the draft, the values will reflect those in the base version.

request_body_param.name: ^^backorder_quantity
request_body_param.desc:
The `backorder_quantity` will automatically be converted to `quantity` once in-stock inventory is sold out. The fulfillment of this inventory follows the `handling_time` specified below.
Note: Made-to-order (MTO), pre-order, and custom products cannot be backordered, and thus are incompatible with backorder_quantity.

request_body_param.name: ^^handling_time
request_body_param.desc: The estimated number of working days needed for a backorder to be shipped. Currently, different warehouses for the same SKU are not allowed to have different `handling_time`

request_body_param.name: ^^quantity
request_body_param.desc:
The total SKU quantity available in the warehouse.
Valid range: [1, 99,999]

Note: This quantity specifically refers to the in-stock inventory that can be shipped immediately.

request_body_param.name: ^^warehouse_id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the warehouse where the SKU is stored. 
Retrieve the list of warehouses available for your shop from the [Get Warehouse List API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa418defece02be6e66b6).

request_body_param.name: ^list_price
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU's list price information. This is equivalent to the manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP), or the recommended retail price (RRP).
Applicable only for the US market.

**Note**: This value may appear as the strikethrough price on the product page. However, whether the strikethrough price is shown and the amount shown are subject to the audit team's review and decision based on various pricing information.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
The price amount.
Valid range: [0.01, 7600]


**Note**: 
- The value must be equal to or greater than `skus.price.amount`. Otherwise, it will be discarded.
- If the value is verified to be legitimate by the audit team, it will be stored and returned in the [Get Product API](6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda).

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc:
The currency.
Possible values: USD

request_body_param.name: ^pre_sale
request_body_param.desc:
SKU presale information, used to tag a product as a presale product based on its presale type.
Applicable only if `allowed_special_product_types` from [Get Category Rules](6509c0febace3e02b74594a9) is not empty.

**Rules for the US market**:
- Regular / Preorder product: Once the product goes live, you cannot change the product type.
- Made-to-order product: You can change it to a regular product at any time.

request_body_param.name: ^^fulfillment_type
request_body_param.desc:
Information about the type of pre-sale order fulfillment and the corresponding timeframe.
- `handling_duration_days` is for fulfillment with an extended duration.
- `release_date` is for starting fulfillment on a fixed date.

**Note**: Provide either the `handling_duration_days` or the `release_date`, depending on the value of `pre_sale.type` and your shop's region.

request_body_param.name: ^^^handling_duration_days
request_body_param.desc:
The desired duration for handling a pre-sale order and handing it over to a shipping carrier. 

Applicable only for the following regions and pre-sale type:
**US**
- `MADE_TO_ORDER`: Business days, from 3 to 14 days.
- `CUSTOM`: Business days, from 3 to 30 days.

**UK, EU, SEA, JP, and LATAM**
- `PRE_ORDER`: Calendar days, from 3 to 30 days.

request_body_param.name: ^^^release_date
request_body_param.desc:
The date on which the product gets converted into a regular product and becomes available for general purchase. On this date, order handling will also start, changing the status of the order to [`AWAITING_SHIPMENT`](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650b1b4bbace3e02b76d1011). 

Applicable only for `PRE_ORDER` in the US.
**Note**:
- Valid range: The date must fall within 3 - 60 days from the current date.
- This date is a unix timestamp (seconds) based on the seller-selected timezone in Seller Center.
- This date cannot be modified once the product goes live.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of pre-sale.
Possible values based on the region:
**US**
- `PRE_ORDER`: The product is not yet available or released. Fulfillment can be extended by specifying a **release date**.
- `MADE_TO_ORDER`: The product is produced only after the order is received. Fulfillment can be extended by specifying a **duration**.
- `CUSTOM`: The product requires a fulfillment timeline that exceeds the standard due to other factors. Fulfillment can be extended by specifying a **duration**.

**UK, EU, SEA, JP, and LATAM**
- `PRE_ORDER`: The product is not yet available or released. Fulfillment can be extended by specifying a **duration**.

request_body_param.name: ^price
request_body_param.desc: SKU pricing information.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
**Local sellers/Intra-EU sellers**
The SKU's **local display price** shown on the product page before any discounts. Refer to [Product Pricing](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e1288d76cfee049d9af858) for the allowed price ranges in each market.

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc:
The currency.
Possible values based on the region:
- BRL: Brazil
- CZK: Czech Republic
- EUR: France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Greece, Portugal
- GBP: United Kingdom
- HUF: Hungary
- IDR: Indonesia
- JPY: Japan
- MXN: Mexico
- MYR: Malaysia
- PHP: Philippines
- PLN: Poland
- SGD: Singapore
- THB: Thailand
- USD: United States
- VND: Vietnam

request_body_param.name: ^^sale_price
request_body_param.desc:
**Global sellers**
The SKU's **local display price** shown on the product page before any discounts. 
Refer to [Product Pricing](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e1288d76cfee049d9af858) for the allowed price ranges in each market.

**Note**: 
- Applicable for all global sellers.
- Required for JP and US shops using China warehouses. Optional for others.
- This is the definitive final price shown on the product page, all other prices will be ignored.

request_body_param.name: ^sales_attributes
request_body_param.desc:
A list of attributes  (e.g. size, color, length) that define each variant of a product.

**Note**: 
- You must retain at least 1 sales attribute, deleting all existing sales attributes is not allowed.
- You can only have up to 3 types of sales attributes per product.
- Each SKU must include the same number and type of sales attributes. For example, you cannot have one SKU that has only a Color attribute, while another SKU has both Color and Size attributes.
- Provide either a built-in ID or a custom name; if both are provided, the ID takes priority.
- The `id/name` and `value_id/value_name` pairs must be unique in each SKU. For example, you cannot repeat `"name": "Color"`, `"value_name": "Red"` in different SKUs.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the sales attribute.
This is either a built-in sales attribute ID from [Get Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8) or a custom attribute ID returned after calling [Create Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6502fc8da57708028b42b18a).

request_body_param.name: ^^name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom sales attribute name if the existing attributes do not satisfy your needs. The system will auto-generate an ID after editing.

**Note**: 
- Do not include sensitive characters.
- Max length: 20 characters

request_body_param.name: ^^sku_img
request_body_param.desc:
The default/main image for each value (e.g. red) of the primary sales attribute (e.g. color). This appears in the product options gallery on TikTok Shop.

You can attach images to only 1 type of sales attribute, which will serve as the primary attribute for display. An image must be provided for each value of the primary attribute. For example, if a product has 2 colors and 3 sizes, you can choose to attach images for either the color sales attribute or the size sales attribute. If you choose to attach images for color, you must attach 2 images, one for each color. If you want to add more images, use `supplementary_sku_images`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the image.
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=ATTRIBUTE_IMAGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^^supplementary_sku_images
request_body_param.desc:
A list of supplementary images for each value (e.g. red) of the primary sales attribute (e.g. color) to provide multiple views or details of the product for that attribute value. These appear in the product options gallery on TikTok Shop.

**Note**:
- Max number of image URIs: 8.
- Arrange your image URIs in the sequence that they should appear on TikTok Shop.
- Applicable only for the US market.

request_body_param.name: ^^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the image.
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=ATTRIBUTE_IMAGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value_id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the sales attribute value.
This is either a built-in sales attribute value ID from [Get Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8) or a custom sales attribute value ID returned after calling [Create Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6502fc8da57708028b42b18a).

request_body_param.name: ^^value_name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom sales attribute value if the existing values do not satisfy your needs. The system will auto-generate an ID after editing.

**Note**:
- No duplicates allowed under the same attribute.
- Max length: 50 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^seller_sku
request_body_param.desc:
An internal code/name for managing SKUs, not visible to buyers.  
- Valid length: 1-50 characters
- Format: Text without spaces

request_body_param.name: ^sku_dimensions
request_body_param.desc:
The dimensions of the sku.

Note:
- Provide the dimensions measured after packing the product.
- These values impact the shipping cost, so it is important to ensure that dimensions are accurate. Any discrepancies in measurements may lead to additional shipping fees.
- Optional for ID, TH, VN regions.

request_body_param.name: ^^height
request_body_param.desc:
The package height. A positive whole number.
Note: For the BR market, decimal values using . or , as separators are also accepted but will be rounded to the nearest whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^^length
request_body_param.desc:
The package length. A positive whole number.
Note: For the BR market, decimal values using . or , as separators are also accepted but will be rounded to the nearest whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^^unit
request_body_param.desc:
The unit for the package dimensions.
Possible values based on region:
- US: CENTIMETER, INCH
- Other  regions: CENTIMETER
  
Note: You must use the same system of measurement (metric system or imperial system) for package_weight and package_dimensions. In other words, if you are using KILOGRAM for the weight, you must use CENTIMETER for the dimensions.

request_body_param.name: ^^width
request_body_param.desc:
The package width. A positive whole number.
Note: For the BR market, decimal values using . or , as separators are also accepted but will be rounded to the nearest whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^sku_unit_count
request_body_param.desc:
The total quantity/volume of the product represented by the SKU.
For example, if the SKU represents 500ml of water, this value would be 500 if the unit type is defined as ml.
Valid range: [0.01, 99,999.9999] 
Applicable only for the EU market.

**Note**: 
- This is mainly used to calculate the unit price of the SKU, and is required only if you wish to display the unit price to facilitate easier price comparisons across different products and packaging sizes.
- Unit price = Selling price/(SKU unit count/base unit count). Therefore if you want to obtain the unit price, you would also need to define the "base unit count" and the "unit type" product attributes. Retrieve the relevant information for these product attributes by using the [Get Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c5784a0bb702c0561cc8). The unit price would then be returned in the [Get Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda).

request_body_param.name: ^sku_weight
request_body_param.desc:
The weight of the sku

Note:
- All the products package weight is mandatory by default, except for products under Virtual Products categories.
- Provide the weight measured after packing the product.
- This value impacts the shipping cost, so it is important to ensure that dimensions are accurate. Any discrepancies in measurements may lead to additional shipping fees.
- The package weight will take precedence over package dimensions in fee calculation if the fee based on weight is higher.

request_body_param.name: ^^unit
request_body_param.desc:
The unit for the package weight.
Possible values based on region:
- US: KILOGRAM, POUND
- BR, JP, MX: KILOGRAM, GRAM
- Other countries: KILOGRAM

Note: You must use the same system of measurement (metric system or imperial system) for package_weight and package_dimensions. In other words, if you are using KILOGRAM for the weight, you must use CENTIMETER for the dimensions.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
The package weight, which must be a positive number.
The number format varies based on the unit: 
- GRAM: integer
- KILOGRAM: up to 3 decimal places
- POUND: up to 2 decimal places

request_body_param.name: subscribe_info_edit
request_body_param.desc: All of the Save and Subscribe discount details.

request_body_param.name: ^discount_details
request_body_param.desc: All of the Save and Subscribe discount details.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_level
request_body_param.desc:
An enum that communicated the type of discount:
- REGULAR
- FIRST_ORDER
- RETENTION

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_value
request_body_param.desc: The value of the discount. A value of 10, would indicate a 10% discount

request_body_param.name: ^subscribe_status
request_body_param.desc:
An enum outlining whether the given product has an active Subscribe and Save promotion:
- ENABLED
- NOT_ENABLED

This field is required if the subscription is being created or modified.

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc:
The product title. 
Title length:
- DE, ES, FR, IE, IT, JP, UK, US: [1, 255] 
- BR, MX: [1, 300] 
- Other regions: [25, 255]

request_body_param.name: video
request_body_param.desc:
A product introduction or promotion video to display for your product.

**Recommendations**:
- Aspect ratio: 1:1 
- Resolution: HD 720p or higher
- Duration: 20 - 60 seconds

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the product video.
Use the [Upload Product File API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509dffdc16ffe02b8dc10c5) to upload the video first and obtain the corresponding file ID.

request_body_param.name: is_blind_box
request_body_param.desc: Whether the product is a blind box of lucky bag. For example: PopMart

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^audit
response_param.desc:
Product audit information.
**Note**: Applicable only to products listed on TikTok Shop. Not applicable for products listed only on Tokopedia.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
The product audit status.
Possible values:
- NONE: The product is not applicable for audit because it has not been submitted for listing on this platform, or it is in a draft, frozen, or deactivated state.
- AUDITING: The product is currently being audited.
- APPROVED: If you only edited the `price` or `inventory` fields of an approved product, the product remains approved and the edits are immediately published on the platform.

response_param.name: ^product_id
response_param.desc: The product ID generated by TikTok Shop.

response_param.name: ^skus
response_param.desc: A list of Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) used to identify distinct variants of the product.

response_param.name: ^^external_sku_id
response_param.desc: An external identifier used in an external ecommerce platform. This is used to associate the SKU between TikTok Shop and the external ecommerce platform.

response_param.name: ^^fees
response_param.desc: The fees required for this product based on TikTok Shop policies. Fees are required only for certain product categories, retrieve the requirements from the [Get Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509c0febace3e02b74594a9).

response_param.name: ^^^additional_attribute
response_param.desc:
An optional attribute that provides additional context for the fee. The accepted values may vary by fee type and market.

Possible values for Pfand:
- SINGLE_USE
- REUSABLE
- NOT_APPLICABLE

response_param.name: ^^^amount
response_param.desc:
The fee amount.
Valid range:
- PFAND: [0.00 - 6300.00]

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of fee.
Possible values: PFAND

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop. One product can contain multiple SKU IDs.

response_param.name: ^^sales_attributes
response_param.desc: A list of attributes  (e.g. size, color, length) that define each variant of a product.

response_param.name: ^^^id
response_param.desc:
The sales attribute ID. 
If you included the custom sales attribute name in the request, this is a newly generated ID.

response_param.name: ^^^value_id
response_param.desc:
The sales attribute value ID. 
If you included the custom sales attribute value name in the request, this is a newly generated ID.

response_param.name: ^^seller_sku
response_param.desc: An internal code/name for managing SKUs, not visible to buyers.

69082631ff1d8e04a996fe52.title: Partial Edit Global Product
69082631ff1d8e04a996fe52.env_desc: Partially update an existing global product. Only the fields included in the request are considered for update. If the global product is linked to local products, applicable changes are also synchronized to those markets; check `publish_results` for each market's synchronization result.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_path_param.name: global_product_id
request_path_param.desc: The global product ID generated by TikTok Shop.

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc:
The product title. 
Title length:
- DE, ES, FR, IE, IT, JP, UK, US: [1, 255] 
- MX:[1,300] 
- Other regions: [25, 255]

request_body_param.name: description
request_body_param.desc: The product description in HTML format. **Note**: - The content must conform to the [HTML syntax](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/). All HTML tags are accepted but to optimize display on the TikTok Shop product detail page, the system will automatically convert certain tags into alternative formats, such as rendering `` tags as images. - Max length: 10,000 characters. - Image guidelines: You must use [TikTok Shop image URLs](6509df95defece02be598a22). Max 30 `` tags, each under 4000px with `src`, `width`, and `height` attributes. **Recommendations**: - If you are syncing a pre-existing description from another platform, include the full HTML source description here. - Provide a detailed description, ideally over 300 characters. - Include 3-5 key selling points, each under 250 characters, with supporting images. - Use 1600x1600 px for the image dimensions.

request_body_param.name: category_id
request_body_param.desc:
The product's current category ID. If provided, it must match the existing category; this API cannot change the product category.
- It must be a leaf category that corresponds to the category tree type specified in the `category_version` property.
- It must be a main category (`categories.permission_statuses=AVAILABLE` in [Get Global Categories API](650a03f8f1fd3102b91b338a)).

**Note**: Refer to TikTok Shop Academy for information on product category restrictions.

request_body_param.name: brand_id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the brand of this product.

**Note**: Unauthorized brands won't be displayed on TikTok Shop.

request_body_param.name: main_images
request_body_param.desc:
A list of images to display in the product image gallery.
- Max count: 9
- Arrange your image URIs in the sequence that they should appear on TikTok Shop.
- Image dimensions: [300x300 px, 4000x4000 px]
  
**Recommendations**:
- Use a minimum of 5 images.
- The first image should have a white background. Use the [Optimize Images API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/665692b35d39dc02deb49a97) to change the background to white.

request_body_param.name: ^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the image. 
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=MAIN_IMAGE`. You can use the returned URI directly, or process it through the [Optimize Images API](665692b35d39dc02deb49a97) first and use the resulting URI.

request_body_param.name: skus
request_body_param.desc:
A list of global Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) used to identify distinct variants of the product.

**Note**:
- Max SKUs for EU, JP, UK, US: 300
- Max SKUs for other regions: 100

**Recommendations**: Place the most important variant at the beginning of the array.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc:
The global SKU ID in TikTok Shop. One product can contain multiple SKU IDs.

**Note**: 
- To edit an existing SKU, include its SKU ID.
- Any existing SKU IDs not listed here will result in the deletion of those SKUs. For example, if this product contains 5 SKUs and you only provide 2 SKU IDs, the remaining 3 will be deleted.
- To create new SKUs, leave the SKU ID blank and complete the other fields.

request_body_param.name: ^global_quantity
request_body_param.desc:
The total SKU inventory quantity across all shops globally. 

The inventory for each local shop is automatically calculated when a product is first published. After publishing, this global quantity cannot be manually changed. You can only modify the inventory quantity in each local shop.

request_body_param.name: ^seller_sku
request_body_param.desc:
An internal code/name for managing SKUs, not visible to buyers.  
- Valid length: 1-50 characters
- Format: Text without spaces

request_body_param.name: ^price
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU's **global uniform pre-tax** price that serves as the baseline for calculating the local prices across different markets.

**Note**: 
- Upon publishing, this price will be automatically converted to the local pre-tax price and local display price based on market-specific exchange rates and applicable charges such as shipping costs, taxes, and other fees.
- The auto-conversion will exclude JP and US shops using China warehouses. For these shops, please use `sale_prices` instead.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
The price amount.
Max: 99,999,999.99

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc:
The currency.
Possible values:
- `USD`: Applicable for global sellers
- `EUR`: Applicable for intra-EU sellers

request_body_param.name: ^sales_attributes
request_body_param.desc:
A list of attributes  (e.g. size, color, length) that define each variant of a product.

**Note**: 
- You must retain at least 1 sales attribute, deleting all existing sales attributes is not allowed.
- You can only have up to 3 types of sales attributes per product.
- Each SKU must include the same number and type of sales attributes. For example, you cannot have one SKU that has only a Color attribute, while another SKU has both Color and Size attributes.
- Provide either a built-in ID or a custom name; if both are provided, the ID takes priority.
- The `id/name` and `value_id/value_name` pairs must be unique in each SKU. For example, you cannot repeat `"name": "Color"`, `"value_name": "Red"` in different SKUs.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the sales attribute.
This is either a built-in sales attribute ID from the [Get Global Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a) or a custom attribute ID returned by the [Create Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509de61bace3e02b7489cba).

request_body_param.name: ^^name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom sales attribute name if the built-in attributes do not satisfy your needs. TikTok Shop generates an ID when the partial edit succeeds and returns it in `data.global_skus[].sales_attributes[].id`.

**Note**: 
- Do not include sensitive characters.
- Max length: 20 characters

request_body_param.name: ^^value_id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the sales attribute value.
This is either a built-in sales attribute value ID from the [Get Global Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a) or a custom sales attribute value ID returned by the [Create Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509de61bace3e02b7489cba).

request_body_param.name: ^^value_name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom sales attribute value if the built-in values do not satisfy your needs. TikTok Shop generates an ID when the partial edit succeeds and returns it in `data.global_skus[].sales_attributes[].value_id`.

**Note**:
- No duplicates allowed under the same attribute.
- Max length: 50 characters.
- Supports only alphabets and numbers.

request_body_param.name: ^^sku_img
request_body_param.desc:
An image to display for the SKU.

You can attach images to only 1 type of sales attribute, and you must attach an image for each value of the chosen attribute. For example, if a product has 2 colors and 3 sizes, you can choose to attach images for either the Color sales attribute or the Size sales attribute. If you choose to attach images for Color, you must attach 2 images, one for each color.

request_body_param.name: ^^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the image.
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=ATTRIBUTE_IMAGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^inventory
request_body_param.desc:
SKU inventory information per warehouse.
If multi-warehouse is enabled in Seller Center, you must provide the inventory details for each warehouse. 
Max count: 50

**Note**: `global_quantity` will not take effect if inventory details are provided for each warehouse.

request_body_param.name: ^^global_warehouse_id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the global warehouse where the SKU is stored. 
Retrieve the list of global warehouses available for the seller from the [Get Global Seller Warehouse API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa3f0defece02be6e5ffb).

request_body_param.name: ^^quantity
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU quantity available in the warehouse.
Valid range: [1, 99,999]

request_body_param.name: ^identifier_code
request_body_param.desc:
A regulated identifier code assigned to a product based on international standardized regulations (e.g. GTIN) to ensure the product is universally identifiable across various platforms and systems.

**Note**: Editable only if the product is in DRAFT state. Otherwise, changes are not allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^^code
request_body_param.desc:
The identifier code.

**Format**:
- GTIN: 14 digits 
- EAN: 8, 13, or 14 digits 
- UPC: 12 digits 
- ISBN: 13 digits, or 9 digits ending in capital `X`
- JAN: 8 or 13 digits

**Note**: The identifier code must be unique for each SKU, with no repetition allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of identifier code.
Possible values:
- GTIN
- EAN
- UPC
- ISBN
- JAN

request_body_param.name: ^sku_unit_count
request_body_param.desc:
The total quantity/volume of the product represented by the SKU.
For example, if the SKU represents 500ml of water, this value would be 500 if the unit type is defined as ml.
Valid range: [0.01, 99,999.9999] 
Applicable only for the EU market.

**Note**: 
- This is mainly used to calculate the unit price of the SKU, and is required only if you wish to display the unit price to facilitate easier price comparisons across different products and packaging sizes.
- Unit price = Selling price/(SKU unit count/base unit count). Therefore if you want to obtain the unit price, you would also need to define the "base unit count" and the "unit type" product attributes. Retrieve the relevant information for these product attributes by using the [Get Global Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a). The unit price would then be returned in the [Get Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509e2b0bace3e02b7490c96).

request_body_param.name: ^extra_identifier_codes
request_body_param.desc:
If the SKU belongs to a virtual bundle (containing multiple individual SKUs), you can add up to 10 additional identifier codes here for the SKUs included in the bundle.

**Format**:
GTIN: 14 digits 
EAN: 8, 13, or 14 digits 
UPC: 12 digits 
ISBN: 13 digits, or 9 digits ending in capital `X`

**Note**: 
- Applicable only for the EU market. 
- The identifier code must be unique for each SKU, with no repetition allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^external_global_sku_id
request_body_param.desc:
An external identifier used in an external ecommerce platform. This is used to associate the global SKU between TikTok Shop and the external ecommerce platform. 
Max length: 999 characters

request_body_param.name: ^sale_prices
request_body_param.desc:
The SKU's **local display price** shown on the product page before any discounts. 

**Note**: 
-  Required for JP and US shops using China warehouses, optional for others.
- This is the definitive final price shown on the product page, all other prices will be ignored.

request_body_param.name: ^^region
request_body_param.desc:
The market where you want to sync the sale price.
Possible values:
- DE: Germany
- ES: Spain
- FR: France
- GB: United Kingdom
- ID: Indonesia
- IE: Ireland
- IT: Italy
- JP: Japan
- MY: Malaysia
- PH: Philippines
- SG: Singapore
- TH: Thailand
- US: United States
- VN: Vietnam

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc:
The price amount.
Refer to [Product Pricing](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e1288d76cfee049d9af858) for the allowed price ranges in each market.

request_body_param.name: package_weight
request_body_param.desc:
The weight of the product package.

**Note**:
- Provide the weight measured after packing the product.
- This value impacts the shipping cost, so it is important to ensure that the measurements are accurate. Any discrepancies may lead to additional shipping fees.
- The package weight will take precedence over package dimensions in fee calculation if the fee based on weight is higher.

request_body_param.name: ^value
request_body_param.desc: The package weight, which must be a positive number with up to 3 decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^unit
request_body_param.desc: The unit for the package weight. Only `KILOGRAM` is supported.

request_body_param.name: certifications
request_body_param.desc:
The list of certifications for your product. If a non-empty list is provided, it replaces the existing certifications. If omitted or passed as an empty array, the existing certifications are retained.
Max count: 10

As per TikTok Shop guidelines, certifications are required for certain restricted product categories. Retrieve the certification requirements for your product from the [Get Global Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a056df1fd3102b91b5b8e). Refer to [TikTok Shop Restricted Products Policy](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?identity=1&role=1&knowledge_id=3238037484275457&from=policy) for information on product category restrictions.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID to identify the type of certification required for the product category.
Retrieve this value from the [Get Global Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a056df1fd3102b91b5b8e).

request_body_param.name: ^images
request_body_param.desc: A list of certification related images.

request_body_param.name: ^^uri
request_body_param.desc:
The URI of the image. 
Obtain this URI by uploading the images through the [Upload Product Image API](6509df95defece02be598a22)  with `use_case=CERTIFICATION_IMAGE`.

request_body_param.name: ^files
request_body_param.desc: A list of certification related files.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the certification file.
Use the [Upload Product File API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509dffdc16ffe02b8dc10c5) to upload the files first and obtain the corresponding file ID.

request_body_param.name: ^^name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the certification file, including the file extension.

request_body_param.name: ^^format
request_body_param.desc: The format of the certification file. Only PDF is supported.

request_body_param.name: package_dimensions
request_body_param.desc:
The dimensions of the product package.

**Note**:
- Provide the dimensions measured after packing the product.
- These values impact the shipping cost, so it is important to ensure that dimensions are accurate. Any discrepancies may lead to additional shipping fees.

request_body_param.name: ^length
request_body_param.desc: The package length. A positive whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^width
request_body_param.desc: The package width. A positive whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^height
request_body_param.desc: The package height. A positive whole number.

request_body_param.name: ^unit
request_body_param.desc: The unit for the package dimensions. Only `CENTIMETER` is supported.

request_body_param.name: product_attributes
request_body_param.desc:
A list of general attributes (e.g. manufacturer, country of origin, materials used) that describe the product as a whole, regardless of variant. If a non-empty list is provided, it replaces the existing product attributes. If omitted or passed as an empty array, the existing product attributes are retained.

**Important**: The attributes available for use are determined by the system based on the product's assigned category, with some being mandatory. You must provide the product attributes marked as `is_required` in the response of the [Get Global Attributes API](650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a).

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc: The ID of the product attribute, retrieved from the [Get Global Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a).

request_body_param.name: ^values
request_body_param.desc:
A list of selectable values for the product attribute.
Max count: 300 for US; 100 for other regions.

**Note**: Provide either a built-in ID or a custom name; if both are provided, the ID takes priority.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc:
The ID of the product attribute value.
This is either a built-in product attribute value ID from the [Get Global Attributes API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a) or a custom product attribute value ID returned by the [Create Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509de61bace3e02b7489cba).

request_body_param.name: ^^name
request_body_param.desc:
A self-defined custom product attribute value if the built-in values do not satisfy your needs. The system will auto-generate an ID after listing.

**Note**: 
- No duplicates allowed under the same attribute.
- Max length: 2000 characters
- Supports only alphabets and numbers.

request_body_param.name: size_chart
request_body_param.desc:
The measurement details of the product to help buyers find the right size. If omitted, the existing size chart is retained. Pass an empty object to remove the existing size chart. Otherwise, the provided object replaces the existing size chart.

**Note**:
- For certain product categories, size charts may be required or not supported. Use the [Get Global Category Rules API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a056df1fd3102b91b5b8e) to check the requirements.

Search live products and retrieve the product information needed by a compliance vendor to prepare a compliance testing report. The selection behavior is:
- If `product_ids` is non-empty, the operation retrieves those known products. This branch takes precedence; seller, product-title, category, and brand filters and pagination are not used to select products.

69dde24dcb1ea3049af16700.title: Submit Product via Opportunity
69dde24dcb1ea3049af16700.env_desc:
Submit an existing product as a response to a specific opportunity lead. The product must belong to the authorized shop and be in `ACTIVATE` status. It will be linked to the opportunity and enter the standard submission review flow.

If you need a new local product, call the [Create Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/create-product-202309) with `save_mode=LISTING`, use the returned `data.product_id`, and wait until the product reaches `ACTIVATE`. A product saved with `save_mode=AS_DRAFT` is not yet eligible. For a global seller that has not migrated to local replication, first call the [Create Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509de61bace3e02b7489cba) to get a `global_product_id`, then call the [Publish Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/publish-global-product-202309). From `data.products`, select the local product `id` for the authorized shop and wait until that product reaches `ACTIVATE` before submitting it here.

After submission, use the [Get Submission Records API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-submission-records-202604) and filter by `opportunity_id` or `product_id` to track the review outcome.

69fc5eec3eb855049985f99f.title: Submit Size Chart Appeal
69fc5eec3eb855049985f99f.env_desc:
#### Appeal Size Chart Verification
Initiates an appeal process for a product that was blocked during the listing phase due to a size chart verification failure.
This API is used when a seller believes their product was incorrectly blocked by our automated size chart validation system. The validation checks for three potential issues:
1. Whether the size chart contains all mandatory dimensions.
2. Whether the size chart covers all Stock-Keeping Units (SKUs) for sale.
3. Whether the numerical values within the size chart are valid.
If the validation system detects an issue, the product listing will be blocked. By using this API, sellers can submit an appeal. If the appeal is approved, the block will be lifted, and the seller can re-list the product.
Use the `[Appeal Status Webhook]` to monitor the appeal's progress, or pass the `appeal_id` to the `[Get Appeal Status API]` to retrieve the current status.
Note:
- Please wait at least 5 minutes after submitting an appeal before checking its status via the API to ensure the data is synchronized.
- You can submit up to 50 appeals per day. Any requests exceeding this limit will be rejected.

request_body_param.desc:
Template name. Required when size_chart_mode is REUSABLE_TEMPLATE.

6aba32215fe27304c71128cd.title: Submit Strikethrough Price
6aba32215fe27304c71128cd.env_desc:
Submit external pricing information for a product's SKUs so that TikTok Shop can verify the product's list price for use as a strikethrough price. If the submitted information is approved, the verified list price may be displayed as the strikethrough price when a discount applies.

Submitted pricing information expires 90 days after submission and must be resubmitted to continue supporting strikethrough price display.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_header_param.name: Content-Type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

request_path_param.name: product_id
request_path_param.desc: The product ID in TikTok Shop.

request_body_param.name: external_product_id
request_body_param.desc: An external product identifier used on an external ecommerce platform. This value must match the `external_product_id` used when the product was created.

request_body_param.name: skus
request_body_param.desc: A list of SKUs whose external pricing information is submitted for verification. All SKU IDs must belong to the product identified by `product_id`.

request_body_param.name: ^external_retail_price
request_body_param.desc: The SKU retail price on the external ecommerce platform.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc: The retail price amount. The valid range is 0.01 to 7600.

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc: The ISO 4217 currency code. The supported value is `USD`.

request_body_param.name: ^external_sku_id
request_body_param.desc: An external SKU identifier used on an external ecommerce platform. This value must match the `external_sku_id` used when the SKU was created.

request_body_param.name: ^external_transaction_price
request_body_param.desc: The highest actual transaction price recorded for the SKU on the external ecommerce platform during the past 90 days.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc: The transaction price amount. The valid range is 0.01 to 7600, and the value must be equal to or greater than the list price specified when the product was created or edited.

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc: The ISO 4217 currency code. The supported value is `USD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^image

request_body_param.name: ^^^uri
request_body_param.desc: The image URI returned by the Upload Product Image API when the image is uploaded with the `CERTIFICATION_IMAGE` use case.

request_body_param.name: ^^transaction_time
request_body_param.desc: The RFC 3339 time when the highest transaction price was recorded. The time must include a timezone and be within the 90 days before the request.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc: The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information.

response_param.name: ^errors
response_param.desc: Item-level failures for SKUs that could not be submitted. The array is empty when every requested SKU is accepted for verification.

response_param.name: ^^code
response_param.desc: The stable business failure code for this SKU.

response_param.name: ^^detail

response_param.name: ^^^sku_id
response_param.desc: The TikTok Shop SKU ID for which submission failed.

response_param.name: ^^message
response_param.example: The external retail price is invalid. Provide an amount from 0.01 to 7600.
response_param.desc: A human-readable description of the failure and the action needed to correct it.

response_param.desc: Request log.

650c33c155bc3202b762b507.title: Create Promotion Activity
650c33c155bc3202b762b507.env_desc: Use this API to create a product discount activity or a flash deal activity. You cannot create a coupon activity with this API. To do that, you'll need to go to the seller center or the seller app. To update the products or SKUs included in the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Unique name across all your activities. The length must not exceed 50 characters.

request_body_param.name: activity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of activities.
Possible enumerations:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: product discount activity with fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: product discount activities with percentage off.
- `FLASHSALE`: flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: shipping fee discount.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: Buy more save more discount.
- `BUY_X_GET_Y`: Buy X get Y.

request_body_param.name: product_level
request_body_param.desc:
Activity product dimension, values are:
​- PRODUCT: Promotion activity applies at the product (SPU) level. Any and all SKUs that are part of this product will be subject to the promotion.
​- VARIATION: Promotion activity only applies to specified SKUs.
​- SHOP: Promotion activity applies to all products in the shop.
When `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`, the `product_level` can not be `VARIATION`.
To set the products or SKUs covered by the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_body_param.name: duration_type
request_body_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

request_body_param.name: begin_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity end time. UNIX timestamp.

request_body_param.name: participation_limit
request_body_param.desc: The number of times a buyer can participate in the promotion.

request_body_param.name: ^type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion activity limits the number of times each buyer can receive its benefit. e.g.:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

request_body_param.name: discount
request_body_param.desc: Discount information.

request_body_param.name: ^shipping_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for the shipping discount, including purchase criteria, discount value, shipping method, inventory type, and area scope.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the threshold type, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of benefit awarded by the promotion activity. 
-When `FREE_SHIPPING`, the buyer's cost of shipping is reduced to zero.
​-When `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, the discount is reduced by the value specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `discount_type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not required.
- `discount_type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's price of shipping in local currency. 
The value should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^shipping_method
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory_type
request_body_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^area_scope
request_body_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`

request_body_param.name: ^^^specific_areas
request_body_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

request_body_param.name: ^bmsm_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

request_body_param.name: ^^details
request_body_param.desc:
Configurations regarding BMSM promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted. `details.threshold_type` and `details.discount_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `discount_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`20` and `discount_value`== `15`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `20` and `discount_value`>`15`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
​- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`​: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^gift_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_receiving_type
request_body_param.desc:
The receiving type of gift. Currently only supports one type: `ALL_RECEIVE`
-`ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_infos
request_body_param.desc:
Configurations regarding Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted in SEA and UK. Only one `tier` is permitted in US. And `threshold_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.
