response_param.name: ^^^last_name
response_param.desc:
Kanji last name
Applicable only for the JP market.

response_param.name: ^^^first_name_local_script
response_param.desc:
Hiragana or Katakana first name
Applicable only for the JP market.

response_param.name: ^^^last_name_local_script
response_param.desc:
Hiragana or Katakana last name
Applicable only for the JP market.

response_param.name: ^^^postal_code
response_param.desc: Warehouse address postal code (also known as zip code)

response_param.name: ^^^full_address
response_param.desc: The combined warehouse address, including the street address and other address information such as apartment number, building, floor..etc (optional)

response_param.name: ^^^region_code
response_param.desc: Warehouse region code.

response_param.name: ^^^phone_number
response_param.desc: Warehouse phone number.

response_param.name: ^^^address_line1
response_param.desc:
The first line of the warehouse address, like street name and street number.
Note: 
- For Brazilian market, this represents the neighborhood or district.
- For the JP market, this represents the district (Chome), block (Banchi), building number (Go).

response_param.name: ^^^address_line2
response_param.desc:
The second line of the warehouse address, like flat, apartment, or suit.
Note: For the Brazilian market, this represents the street name.

response_param.name: ^^^address_line3
response_param.desc:
This represents the street number. If it's `s/n`, it means null.
Note: Available only in the Brazilian market.

response_param.name: ^^^address_line4
response_param.desc:
This represents supplement information, like flat, apartment, or suit (optional).
Note: Available only in the Brazilian market.

response_param.name: ^^^geolocation
response_param.desc: The geographical location of the address.

response_param.name: ^^^^latitude
response_param.desc: The latitude of the address.

650ab6c2c16ffe02b8f2efcf.title: Approve Return
650ab6c2c16ffe02b8f2efcf.env_desc: Use this API to approve a buyer's return request. The exact effect depends on the return type and return status. Before calling this API, make sure the return is still awaiting a seller action that matches the decision you are sending.

request_query_param.name: idempotency_key
request_query_param.desc: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_path_param.name: return_id
request_path_param.desc: The unique identifier of the return request to be approved by the seller.

request_body_param.name: decision
request_body_param.desc:
Seller's decision for the return request, available values:
- `APPROVE_REFUND`: seller approve a refund-only request
- `APPROVE_RETURN`: seller approve the initial return-and-refund request
- `APPROVE_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`: seller approve return-and-refund request after the buyer has already shipped or handed over the item.
- `APPROVE_REPLACEMENT`: seller approve replacement request
- `ISSUE_REPLACEMENT_REFUND`: seller decline the replacement request and directly refund the buyer instead.
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`: seller offers a partial refund amount to the buyer without requiring the item(s) to be returned.
- `DIRECT_REFUND`: seller issues a returnless refund, meaning the buyer receives a full refund and keeps the item

request_body_param.name: buyer_keep_item
request_body_param.desc: **Optional**. Use this field only when decision is set to `APPROVE_RETURN`. If set to `true`, the seller issues a returnless refund, which means the buyer receives a full refund and keeps the item.

request_body_param.name: partial_refund
request_body_param.desc: **Required**. when decision is set to `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND` Omit this field for all other decisions.

request_body_param.name: ^currency
request_body_param.desc: Refund currency must match the currency of the current return request.

request_body_param.name: ^amount
request_body_param.desc: The partial refund amount seller would like to offer to the buyer

request_body_param.name: return_status
request_body_param.desc:
List of return status.
Available values:
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a return or refund request. The request is pending review by seller or system. 
- `REFUND_OR_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT`: The return or refund request was rejected. 
- `AWAITING_BUYER_SHIP`: The return request was approved. The seller is waiting for the buyer to ship the approved items to the seller. If the buyer doesn't ship the items to the seller before the deadline, the platform will close the request.
- `BUYER_SHIPPED_ITEM`: Buyer has shipped the approved items to seller.
- `REJECT_RECEIVE_PACKAGE`: Seller inspected the returned items and rejected the return request. 
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_SUCCESS`: The return/refund request was successful. The buyer will be refunded.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_CANCEL`: The request has been cancelled by the buyer or system.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: The return/refund was processed successfully. The buyer has been refunded.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a replacement request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REJECT`: Seller reject the buyer replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's replacement request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's replacement request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_RESPONSE`: Seller offer another return type to the buyer, and waiting buyer response. Seller proposed return type can check the `seller_proposed_return_type`.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated an exchange request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's exchange request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the exchange request.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's exchange request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.

- `PARTIAL_REFUND`

request_body_param.name: create_time_ge
request_body_param.desc:
Filter returns to show only those that are created on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

Note:
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_le` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `create_time_ge` is filled but `create_time_le` is empty, `create_time_le` will default to the current time.
- If `create_time_lt` is filled but `create_time_ge` is empty, `create_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

request_body_param.name: arbitration_status
request_body_param.desc:

Available values:
- `IN_PROGRESS`: The TikTok Shop platform operator is processing arbitration. Platform may request additional information from the seller.  
- `SUPPORT_BUYER`: The platform operator supports buyer.
- `SUPPORT_SELLER`: The platform operator supports seller.
- `CLOSED`: Arbitration is closed.

request_body_param.name: update_time_ge
request_body_param.desc:

Note:
`update_time_ge` and `update_time_le` together define the update time filter condition.
- If `update_time_ge` is filled but `update_time_le` is empty, `update_time_le` will default to the current time.
- If `update_time_lt` is filled but `update_time_ge` is empty, `update_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

69c3070c66dee40493fdfe2e.title: Get Aftersale Eligibility

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token

Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

response_param.name: ^^^return_type
response_param.desc:
Return type.
Available values:
- `REFUND`: Seller will issue a refund without return. The buyer is not required to send the item(s) back to the seller.
- `RETURN_AND_REFUND`: Buyer is required to send the item(s) back to the seller. The seller will need to review the condition of the returned item(s) before a refund can be issued to the buyer.
- `REPLACEMENT`: The buyer requires the seller to replace the item(s).
- `EXCHANGE`: The buyer requires the seller to exchange the item(s).

response_param.name: ^^^return_status
response_param.desc:
Return status.
Available values:
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a return or refund request. The request is pending review by seller or platform.
- `REFUND_OR_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT`: The return or refund request was rejected.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_SHIP`: The return request was approved. The seller is waiting for the buyer to ship the approved items to the seller. If the buyer doesn't ship the items to the seller before the deadline, the platform will close the request.
- `BUYER_SHIPPED_ITEM`: Buyer has shipped the approved items to seller.
- `REJECT_RECEIVE_PACKAGE`: Seller inspected the returned items and rejected the return package.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_SUCCESS`: The return/refund request was approved. The buyer will be refunded.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_CANCEL`: The request has been cancelled by the buyer or system.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: The return/refund was processed successfully. The buyer has been refunded.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a replacement request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REJECT`: Seller reject the buyer replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's replacement request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's replacement request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_RESPONSE`: Seller offer another return type to the buyer, and waiting buyer response. Seller proposed return type can check the `seller_proposed_return_type`.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated an exchange request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's exchange request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the exchange request.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's exchange request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.

- `CLOSED`: Arbitration is closed

response_param.name: ^^^return_type
response_param.desc:
Return type.
Available values:
- `REFUND`: Seller will issue a refund without return. The buyer is not required to send the item(s) back to the seller.
- `RETURN_AND_REFUND`: Buyer is required to send the item(s) back to the seller. The seller will need to review the condition of the returned item(s) before a refund can be issued to the buyer.
- `REPLACEMENT`: The buyer requires the seller to replace the item(s).
- `EXCHANGE`: The buyer requires the seller to exchange the item(s).

response_param.name: ^^^return_status
response_param.desc:
Return status.
Available values:
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a return or refund request. The request is pending review by seller or platform.
- `REFUND_OR_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT`: The return or refund request was rejected.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_SHIP`: The return request was approved. The seller is waiting for the buyer to ship the approved items to the seller. If the buyer doesn't ship the items to the seller before the deadline, the platform will close the request.
- `BUYER_SHIPPED_ITEM`: Buyer has shipped the approved items to seller.
- `REJECT_RECEIVE_PACKAGE`: Seller inspected the returned items and rejected the return package.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_SUCCESS`: The return/refund request was approved. The buyer will be refunded.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_CANCEL`: The request has been cancelled by the buyer or system.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: The return/refund was processed successfully. The buyer has been refunded.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a replacement request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REJECT`: Seller reject the buyer replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's replacement request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's replacement request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_RESPONSE`: Seller offer another return type to the buyer, and waiting buyer response. Seller proposed return type can check the `seller_proposed_return_type`.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated an exchange request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's exchange request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the exchange request.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's exchange request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.

650a676f0fcef602bf2b91f0.title: Get Statements
650a676f0fcef602bf2b91f0.env_desc:
Retrieves the statements generated for a shop and the key statement information based on a specified date range or their payment status. Use this API to get an overview of your daily statements over a range of time, or to find out which statements have been paid or not. For the detailed transactions, refer to [Get Statement Transactions](650a6749defece02be67da87) or [Get Order Statement Transactions](650a6734defece02be67d724).
Applicable for all regions' sellers. Only data after 2023-07-01 is available.

request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: statement_time_lt
request_query_param.desc:
Filter statements to show only those that are generated before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `statement_time_ge` for more usage information.

request_query_param.name: payment_status
request_query_param.desc:
Filter statements based on the payment status.
Possible values:
- PAID: Payment has been transferred to the seller.
- FAILED: Payment transfer failed.
- PROCESSING: Payment is currently being processed.
Default: All statuses are returned.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Default: 20
Valid range: [1-100]

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

request_query_param.name: sort_field
request_query_param.desc: The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. Only supports `statement_time`.

request_query_param.name: sort_order
request_query_param.desc:
The sort order for the `sort_field` parameter. 
Default: ASC 
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

request_query_param.name: statement_time_ge
request_query_param.desc:
Filter statements to show only those that are generated on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

**Note:**
`statement_time_ge` and `statement_time_le` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `statement_time_ge` is filled but `statement_time_lt` is empty, `statement_time_lt` will default to the current time.
- If `statement_time_lt` is filled but `statement_time_ge` is empty, `statement_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

**Example:**
As statements are generated daily at 00:00 UTC, to retrieve statements for the period from Oct 5 to Oct 10, configure the parameters as follows:
- Set `statement_time_ge` to 00:00 on Oct 6  or any time on Oct 5 (excluding 00:00).
- Set `statement_time_lt` to any time on Oct 11 (excluding 00:00).

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The transaction ID.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The transaction type.

**Standard transactions**
- `ORDER`: A transaction related to an order settlement.
- `RESERVE`: A transaction involving collection or release of reserve funds.
- If the transaction is an adjustment, it returns one of the following values:

**Platform-related adjustments**
- `CHARGE_BACK`: Charges returned to a payment card after a customer has successfully disputed an item on their account statement or transactions report.
- `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_COMPENSATION`: Extra compensation or compensation paid to a customer after the after-sales period by customer service.
- `DEDUCTIONS_INCURRED_BY_SELLER`: Deduction arising from customer dissatisfaction as a result of the seller's responsibility. This includes issues such as fraud, empty packages, items that do not match the product display page, or items of lower value than advertised.
- `GMV_PAYMENT_FOR_ADS`: Amount used to pay for your advertisement if you are enabled "auto pay ads with shop GMV", or to pay for Tiktok Promote ads orders.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_PENALTY`: Penalty imposed for a violation of TikTok Shop policies (the corresponding amount has been deducted from the seller's account). For details, please refer to the email notification sent to the seller.
- `PROMOTION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when a seller takes part in a platform promotion and there are differences between the promotion price and the actual amount paid by the seller.
- `REBATE`: A discount on referral fees offered by TikTok Shop to eligible sellers.
- `PLATFORM_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller after the seller successfully appealed for a customer dispute.
- `PLATFORM_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded under TikTok's refund without return policy (the seller is not responsible).
- `COFUNDED_CREATOR_REWARDS`: Fees charged for joining the co-funded creator rewards program to reward creator activities.
- `STAMP_DUTY`: To comply with Thailand's tax regulations, TikTok Shop withholds and remits the stamp duty levied on the withholding tax agent appointment letter. This document falls under Instrument No. 21 (Agency) and is subject to a THB 30 stamp duty.

**Logistics-related adjustments**
- `FBT_WAREHOUSE_SERVICE_FEE`: Amount charged by TikTok Fulfillment Portal (Pipak) for warehousing-related bills incurred by the seller under the Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) service.
- `LOGISTICS_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded due to logistics-related issues (e.g. lost or damaged order).
- `SHIPPING_FEE_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences or mistakes with the shipping fee paid by the seller.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_COMPENSATION`: Compensation given to sellers due to differences between the actual shipping fee and the pre-paid shipping fee.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_REBATE`: Shipping fee rebate provided to the seller as part of their participation in a platform campaign.
- `SAMPLE_SHIPPING_FEE`: Fees charged for sending samples using the TikTok logistics provider.
- `SELLER_MISSION_REWARD`: Platform provided cash reward for seller mission completion.
- `Violation fee （settlement fee）`: The deduction to cover the cost of buyer's losses for the unpleasant experience of the buyer due to an issue that is the seller's responsibility.
- `Violation fee （credit card）`: The amount owed to TikTok Shop from previous transactions, charged to your primary credit card.
- `Bill payment （negative balance）`: The amount you owe TikTok Shop, charged to your primary credit card.
-  `Sales proceed（negative balance） `:Sales proceed that is ready to pay for negeative balance.
-  `Bill deduction for negative balance `:Deduction for the amount you owe TikTok Shop after all platform fees are deducted from your net earnings.

**Miscellaneous adjustments**
`OTHER_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment for other reasons.

68886ace1564fc04a94bd525.title: Get Unsettled Transactions
68886ace1564fc04a94bd525.env_desc:
This API allows the partner to retrieve a list of unsettled transactions (incl. Orders & Adjustments) generated by a seller, returning the detailed fee breakdown for a list of order ID and adjustment ID. 
For now, this API only returns transactions which were created after 2025.01.01. Once one transaction is settled, which won't be returned by this API anymore, please get from Get Statement Transaction API. 
**Pay attention to that all data returned through this API is an estimated amount which subject to change before settlement and can only used for seller's reference, final settlement amount per each transaction can only provided through statement related API.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Default: 20
Valid range: [1-100]

request_query_param.name: sort_field
request_query_param.desc: The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. Only supports `order_create_time`.

request_query_param.name: sort_order
request_query_param.desc:
The sort order for the `sort_field` parameter. 
Default: ASC 
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

request_query_param.name: search_time_ge
request_query_param.desc:
Filter statements to show only those that are generated on or after the
specified date and time. Unix timestamp. Note:statement_time_ge and statement_time_lt together constitute the creation time filter condition. - If statement_time_ge is filled but statement_time_lt is empty, statement_time_lt will default to the current time. - If statement_time_lt is filled but statement_time_ge is empty, statement_time_ge will default to 20250101.

request_query_param.name: search_time_lt
request_query_param.desc: the search range's end time

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: The number of transaction records in the statement.

response_param.name: ^sum_est_settlement_amount
response_param.desc: The sum of the estimated settlement amount.

response_param.name: ^sum_est_revenue_amount
response_param.desc: The sum of the estimated revenue amount.

response_param.name: ^sum_est_adjustment_amount
response_param.desc: The sum of the estimated adjustment amount.

response_param.name: ^sum_est_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The sum of the estimated fee amount.

response_param.name: ^transactions
response_param.desc: The list of transaction records in the statement. Each transaction corresponds to an order, an adjustment, or a reserve-related transaction.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The transaction type.
Standard transactions
- `ORDER`: A transaction related to an order settlement.
- If the transaction is an adjustment, it returns one of the following values:
Platform-related adjustments
- `CHARGE_BACK`: Charges returned to a payment card after a customer has successfully disputed an item on their account statement or transactions report.
- `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_COMPENSATION`: Extra compensation or compensation paid to a customer after the after-sales period by customer service.
- `DEDUCTIONS_INCURRED_BY_SELLER`: Deduction arising from customer dissatisfaction as a result of the seller's responsibility. This includes issues such as fraud, empty packages, items that do not match the product display page, or items of lower value than advertised.
- `GMV_PAYMENT_FOR_ADS`: Amount used to pay for your advertisement if you are enabled "auto pay ads with shop GMV", or to pay for Tiktok Promote ads orders.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_PENALTY`: Penalty imposed for a violation of TikTok Shop policies (the corresponding amount has been deducted from the seller's account). For details, please refer to the email notification sent to the seller.
- `PROMOTION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when a seller takes part in a platform promotion and there are differences between the promotion price and the actual amount paid by the seller.
- `REBATE`: A discount on referral fees offered by TikTok Shop to eligible sellers.
- `PLATFORM_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller after the seller successfully appealed for a customer dispute.
- `PLATFORM_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded under TikTok's refund without return policy (the seller is not responsible).
Logistics-related adjustments
- `FBT_WAREHOUSE_SERVICE_FEE`: Amount charged by TikTok Fulfillment Portal (Pipak) for warehousing-related bills incurred by the seller under the Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) service.
- `LOGISTICS_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded due to logistics-related issues (e.g. lost or damaged order).
- `SHIPPING_FEE_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences or mistakes with the shipping fee paid by the seller.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_COMPENSATION`: Compensation given to sellers due to differences between the actual shipping fee and the pre-paid shipping fee.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_REBATE`: Shipping fee rebate provided to the seller as part of their participation in a platform campaign.
- `SAMPLE_SHIPPING_FEE`: Fees charged for sending samples using the TikTok logistics provider.
Miscellaneous adjustments
`OTHER_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment for other reasons.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The transaction ID.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc: The transaction status. Only supports `UNSETTLED`.

response_param.name: ^^currency
response_param.desc: The three-digit currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^estimated_settlement
response_param.desc:
Estimated settlement time for this transaction. 
Possible return value:
- x days after delivery: when order hasn't been delivered and only rough settlement policy been provided
- Unix timestamp: when order has been delivered and detailed settlement time been calculated out

response_param.name: ^^unsettled_reason
response_param.desc: reason for why transaction is pending for settlement

response_param.name: ^^order_create_time
response_param.desc: The creation time of the order. Unix timestamp.

response_param.name: ^^order_delivery_time
response_param.desc: The delivery time of the order. Unix timestamp. if order hasn't been delivered, no data will be return

response_param.name: ^^order_id
response_param.desc:
The order ID.
Each transaction can only be associated with an order ID or an adjustment ID.

response_param.name: ^^adjustment_id
response_param.desc:
The adjustment ID if the transaction is an adjustment.
Each transaction can only be associated with an order ID or an adjustment ID.

response_param.name: ^^adjustment_order_id
response_param.desc: The order ID associated with the adjustment, if any.

response_param.name: ^^est_adjustment_amount
response_param.desc:
The estimated adjustment amount based on TikTok Shop policy. 
Refer to `transactions.type` for the list of adjustment-related policies.

response_param.name: ^^est_settlement_amount
response_param.desc:
The estimated settlement amount for the order.
Formula: revenue_amount - shipping_cost_amount - fee_tax_amount - adjustment_amount

response_param.name: ^^est_revenue_amount
response_param.desc: The estimated revenue amount. This is equivalent to the sum of all amounts in `revenue_breakdown`.

response_param.name: ^^revenue_breakdown
response_param.desc: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `revenue_amount`.

response_param.name: ^^^subtotal_before_discount_amount
response_param.desc: The total price of all order items before any seller discounts and platform discounts are deducted. This is equivalent to the shop's gross sales.

response_param.name: ^^^seller_discount_amount
response_param.desc:
The total amount of discounts funded by the seller, including:
- Seller promotions (Product Discount, Flash Deal, Buy More Save More, Voucher and Bundle Deal)
- Seller's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns
- Seller discounts during a campaign

response_param.name: ^^^refund_subtotal_before_discount_amount
response_param.desc: The total price of all refunded items before any seller discounts. This is equivalent to the shop's gross sales refund.

response_param.name: ^^^seller_discount_refund_amount
response_param.desc: Discounts returned to the sellers due to returns or refunds.

response_param.name: ^^^cod_service_fee_amount
response_param.desc:
The cash on delivery service fees charged to buyers.
Applicable only for Saudi Arabia.

response_param.name: ^^^refund_cod_service_fee_amount
response_param.desc:
The refund for cash on delivery service fees.
Applicable only for Saudi Arabia.

response_param.name: ^^^distant_item_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The distance fee for items paid by the customer. With your current settings for Horizon+ Program, this fee is included in product price for orders with shipping out of Java island.

response_param.name: ^^est_shipping_cost_amount
response_param.desc: The estimated shipping costs, please note that when order hasn't been delivered, no complete shipping cost can be provided. This is equivalent to the sum of all contributory amounts in `shipping_cost_breakdown`.

response_param.name: ^^shipping_cost_breakdown
response_param.desc: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `shipping_cost_amount`.

response_param.name: ^^^actual_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The actual shipping fee calculated based on the weight/dimensions measured by the carrier. For details, check ` shipping_cost_breakdown.supplementary_component`.

response_param.name: ^^^international_leg_logistics_amount
response_param.desc: The delivery fee charged to the seller for the international leg of a cross-border shipment

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_fee_discount_amount
response_param.desc: The shipping fee subsidies and incentives provided by the platform. This includes all subsidies regardless of fulfillment channels or policies. For details, check ` shipping_cost_breakdown.supplementary_component`.

response_param.name: ^^^customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The actual shipping fee borne by the customer, calculated based on the product weight uploaded by the seller.

response_param.name: ^^^return_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of returns.

response_param.name: ^^^replacement_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc:
The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of goods replacement.
Applicable only for Indonesia.

response_param.name: ^^^exchange_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc:
The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of goods exchange.
Applicable only for Indonesia.

response_param.name: ^^^signature_confirmation_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The fee incurred for packages requiring signature confirmation services

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_insurance_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The shipping insurance fee incurred by the seller for purchasing additional TikTok shipping insurance services.

response_param.name: ^^^distant_shipping_fee_amount
response_param.desc: The distance fee for shipping paid by the customer. With your current settings for Horizon+ Program, this fee is included in product price for orders with shipping out of Java island.

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_app_service_fee_amount
response_param.desc: Shipping App Service Fee for using shipping fee to generate shipping labels

response_param.name: ^^^logistics_service_fee
response_param.desc: A fee charged to sellers throughout the order lifecycle for logistics-related services, including processing, coordination, handling of delivery-related matters, and basic shipping incentives. It is an amount per order, which is based on the parcel's weight tier and shipping route. It allows the platform to continuously enhance a high-quality, sustainable logistics network that serves both sellers and customers better over the long term, amidst changing global conditions.

response_param.name: ^^^fbt_overall_merchant_subsidy
response_param.desc: Subsidy applied to your orders and offered to all FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) merchants for the statement period. The amount is calculated based on your qualifying FBT order volume during this period.

response_param.name: ^^^fbt_key_merchant_subsidy
response_param.desc: Subsidy applied to your orders based on eligibility for the key merchant program. The amount is calculated based on your qualifying FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) order volume during the statement period.

response_param.name: ^^^^promo_shipping_incentive_amount

response_param.name: ^^^fee

response_param.name: ^^^^platform_commission_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^referral_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^refund_administration_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^transaction_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^credit_card_handling_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^affiliate_commission_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^sfp_service_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^live_specials_fee_amount

response_param.name: ^^^^retail_delivery_fee_amount

6a27b22ba6ff06049bbbd584.title: Get Payments
6a27b22ba6ff06049bbbd584.env_desc:
**This API is currently unavailable to SEA markets.**
Retrieves records of automated payments for a shop based on a specified date range.
Use the returned list to verify and reconcile payments with the transactions in the seller's bank account.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: create_time_lt
request_query_param.desc:
Filter payments to show only those that occurred before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `create_time_ge` for more usage information.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Default: 20
Valid range: [1-100]

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

request_query_param.name: sort_field
request_query_param.desc: The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. Only supports `create_time`.

request_query_param.name: sort_order
request_query_param.desc:
The sort order for the `sort_field` parameter. 
Default: ASC 
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

request_query_param.name: create_time_ge
request_query_param.desc:
Filter payments to show only those that occurred on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

**Note:**
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `create_time_ge` is filled but `create_time_lt` is empty, `create_time_lt` will default to the current time.
- If `create_time_lt` is filled but `create_time_ge` is empty, `create_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

response_param.name: ^payments
response_param.desc: The list of payments that meet the query conditions.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the payment was initiated in TikTok Shop. Unix timestamp.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The payment ID.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
The payment status, indicating whether payment has been transferred to the seller's bank account.
Possible values:
- PAID: Payment has been transferred to the seller.
- FAILED: Payment transfer failed.
- PROCESSING: Payment is currently being processed.

response_param.name: ^^amount
response_param.desc: The final payment amount after currency exchange.

response_param.name: ^^^value
response_param.desc: The final payment amount.

response_param.name: ^^^currency
response_param.desc: The exchange currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^settlement_amount
response_param.desc: The settlement amount before currency exchange.

response_param.name: ^^^value
response_param.desc: The settlement amount.

response_param.name: ^^^currency
response_param.desc: The original currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^payment_amount_before_exchange
response_param.desc: The original payment amount before currency exchange.

response_param.name: ^^^value
response_param.desc: The original payment amount.

response_param.name: ^^^currency
response_param.desc: The original currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^exchange_rate
response_param.desc: The exchange rate, displayed with six decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^paid_time
response_param.desc: The time when the payment was successfully processed. Unix timestamp.

response_param.name: ^^bank_account
response_param.desc: The seller's bank account number masked, revealing only the last 4 digits for privacy.

6ab389ec34aa1a04d67c2ddf.title: Get TradeIn Account Transactions
6ab389ec34aa1a04d67c2ddf.env_desc:
Retrieves account transaction records for the currently authorized TradeIn supplier.
The supplier identity and associated seller identity are resolved from the authorization context. The caller cannot specify seller_id.
Only account transactions generated by the TradeIn business are returned.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: start_time
request_query_param.desc: Filter account transactions created on or after this time. Use RFC 3339 format with timezone.

request_query_param.name: end_time
request_query_param.desc: Filter account transactions created before this time. Use RFC 3339 format with timezone.

request_query_param.name: flow_type
request_query_param.desc: Filters account transactions by business transaction type. Allowed values: RECHARGE, WITHDRAW, REVERSE. If omitted, all supported transaction types are returned.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: The number of account transactions to return per page.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token returned by the previous request. Omit it when requesting the first page.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^flows
response_param.desc: The TradeIn account transactions that match the query conditions. An empty array is returned when no transaction matches.

response_param.name: ^^amount
response_param.desc: The transaction amount and currency. Use direction to determine whether the transaction is a credit or debit.

response_param.name: ^^^amount
response_param.desc: The transaction amount represented as a decimal string.

response_param.name: ^^^currency
response_param.desc: The currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the account transaction was created, in RFC 3339 format.

response_param.name: ^^direction
response_param.desc:
The direction of the account transaction.
- IN: Funds credited to the supplier's account.
- OUT: Funds debited from the supplier's account.

response_param.name: ^^origin_transaction_id
response_param.desc: The original account transaction ID associated with a reversed transaction. This field is returned only for a REVERSE transaction when available.

response_param.name: ^^reference_id
response_param.desc: The TradeIn business order ID associated with the account transaction.

response_param.name: ^^transaction_id
response_param.desc: The unique ID of the account transaction.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The TradeIn business transaction type.
- RECHARGE: Funds credited through a recharge.
- WITHDRAW: Funds debited through a payout.
- REVERSE: Funds returned after a payout reversal.

response_param.name: ^has_more
response_param.desc: Whether more account transactions are available.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page. The value is empty when no more account transactions are available.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: The total number of account transactions that match the query conditions.

6621101aba28f302e0dd73b0.title: Get Video Performances
6621101aba28f302e0dd73b0.env_desc: Use this US-creator-only API to retrieve TikTok e-commerce video metrics, including anchor_display_rate, click_through_rate, orders, items_sold, and GMV, for the requested videos.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: video_ids
request_query_param.desc: Collection of video IDs for retrieving the e-commerce metrics. Callers must ensure that all video IDs share the same author ID. Limit collection size 100. Use "," to separate array elements when send in the query.

request_query_param.name: start_time_ge
request_query_param.desc:
Start date for the metrics, set with a one-day delay from today due to latency in the data pipeline. The start_time parameter must be within the last 180 days from the current date. Only date value is processed, hour/mininute/second values will be ignored. 
For example, if the start_time value is: 1703507696 ("26-12-2023 04:34:56"), backend service will only consider the part "26-12-2023" when doing the query because by default, in offline data analytics, there is no hour/min/sec data level.

request_query_param.name: end_time_le
request_query_param.desc: End date for the metrics, set with a one-day delay from today due to latency in the data pipeline. Only date value is processed, hour/mininute/second values will be ignored.

response_param.name: code

6a5f09ade90897049c66a0d3.title: Get SPS Metric Diagnosis
6a5f09ade90897049c66a0d3.env_desc:
Returns diagnosis details for a single SPS metric, including benchmark thresholds, trends, calculation details, and distribution details. 
Shop Performance Score (SPS) reflects a shop’s performance across key operational and service metrics on TikTok Shop. By integrating the read-only SPS APIs, ISVs can retrieve a shop’s score, tier, benefits, and metric benchmarks, diagnose performance gaps, and drill down to the products, logistics providers, aftersales types, orders, or chats associated with specific issues. This enables ISVs to embed actionable performance insights into their solutions, helping merchants identify problem areas faster and take targeted actions to improve shop performance. Available only for US-region shops.
Use case guide: [Click here](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/ph0ccose)

request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: start_date_ge
request_query_param.desc:
Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)

request_query_param.name: end_date_lt
request_query_param.desc:
End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)

request_query_param.name: today
request_query_param.desc:
If "today" is set to true, start_date_ge and end_date_lt will be overwritten.
The response will contain real-time metrics of today (local time)

request_query_param.name: granularity
request_query_param.desc:
Granularity of the data.
Available values:
- ALL: Aggregate data for the full requested time range.
- 1D: Daily data.
Default value: ALL

request_query_param.name: currency
request_query_param.desc:
Currently, only local currency is supported in the response.

Available values:
- USD: US dollars.
- LOCAL: Local currency where the shop is located.
Default value: LOCAL

request_query_param.name: account_type
request_query_param.desc:
Types of the accounts under which videos were created.
Available values:
- ALL: All account types.
- LINKED_ACCOUNTS: Linked accounts.
- AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS: Affiliate accounts.
Default value: ALL

request_body_param.desc: A list of product keywords for searching. Product titles, or names, are loosely matched. Keywords in the list form a query and the resulting set of matching product names is based on the conjunctive operator `AND` between each keyword. For example, the keyword list `["Men", "Fashion"]` creates a query `"Men" AND "Fashion"` and the resulting set of matching product names contains the loosely matched conjuction of "Men" and "Fashion" such as "Male Fashionable". request_body_param.name: application_statuses
request_body_param.desc:
The status of sample applications.
The possible enumerated values are:
- PENDING: The sample application is waiting for the seller's review.
- AWAITING_SHIPMENT: The application is approved, and the seller needs to ship the sample.
- SHIPPED: The sample has been shipped by the seller and is waiting for the creator to receive the package.
- CONTENT_PENDING: The creator has received the sample package and is expected to create content.
- REJECT_CANCELLED: The sample application has been rejected by the seller.
- OVERDUE_CANCELLED: The sample application has expired due to being overdue.
- UNFULFILL_CANCELLED: The creator did not fulfill the commitment to create content within the agreed timeframe.
- DEL_OPEN_COLLAB: Open collaboration has been deleted.
- SELLER_NOT_SHIP_CANCELLED: The seller did not ship the sample within the required timeframe.
- WITHDRAW_CANCELLED: The creator withdrew the sample application before the seller approved it.
- UNFULFILLABLE_CANCELLED: The application was cancelled due to reasons beyond the creator's control, making it impossible to create content.
- OPS_CANCELLED: The application was manually cancelled by operations staff.
- OPS_FAILED: The application was marked as failed by operations staff.
- OPS_ COMPLETED: The application was manually marked as completed by operations staff.
- COMPLETED: The application is complete, and the creator has posted the content.
This field allows for tracking the status of a sample application throughout its lifecycle, providing visibility into each stage of the process for sellers and creators.

response_param.name: ^^^bound_product_status
response_param.desc:
Represents the marketing status of a product associated with a fulfillment order. It indicates whether the product is available for marketing and fulfillment. The possible values are:

- LIVE: The product is available and can be used for fulfillment.
- OUT_OF_STOCK: The product is out of stock and cannot be fulfilled.
- SELLER_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the seller.
- PLATFORM_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the platform.
- NO_PLAN: There is no valid plan available for the creator to market the product.

This field helps sellers and creators understand the current status of products associated with fulfillment orders, ensuring that all parties are aware of the availability and marketing status of the products involved in sample applications and collaborations.

- PENDING: The sample application is waiting for the seller's review.
- AWAITING_SHIPMENT: The application is approved, and the seller needs to ship the sample.
- SHIPPED: The sample has been shipped by the seller and is waiting for the creator to receive the package.
- CONTENT_PENDING: The creator has received the sample package and is expected to create content.
- REJECT_CANCELLED: The sample application has been rejected by the seller.
- OVERDUE_CANCELLED: The sample application has expired due to being overdue.
- UNFULFILL_CANCELLED: The creator did not fulfill the commitment to create content within the agreed timeframe.
- SELLER_NOT_SHIP_CANCELLED: The seller did not ship the sample within the required timeframe.
- WITHDRAW_CANCELLED: The creator withdrew the sample application before the seller approved it.
- UNFULFILLABLE_CANCELLED: The application was cancelled due to reasons beyond the creator's control, making it impossible to create content.
- OPS_CANCELLED: The application was manually cancelled by operations staff.
- OPS_FAILED: The application was marked as failed by operations staff.
- OPS_ COMPLETED: The application was manually marked as completed by operations staff.
- COMPLETED: The application is complete, and the creator has posted the content.

request_body_param.desc:
Settlement Status of the order.
Possible values:
1. "CUSTOMER UNPAID",  customer hasn't paid for the orders.
2. "PENDING", customers can still return or get a refund for this order. The earnings shown are estimates and waiting for settlement.
3. "SETTLED", your earnings have already settled to your account
4. "INELIGIBLE", The order has been returned/refunded/canceled by the buyer, and no commission will be settled.
5. "FROZEN", Possible fraud has been detected regarding the order. The commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

This API is used to create a target collaboration.
A target collaboration is a collaboration between a seller selected set of products (including a commission payout) and a set of creators the seller has added (invited) to the collaboration. Target collaborations are private and not visible in the Creator Marketplace to all creators; they are only visible to those that have been added to the collaboration.

request_body_param.desc: A list of metadata and data for the products provided by the seller for target collaboration. Maximum length of the list is `100` products.

request_body_param.desc: The product identifier.

request_body_param.name: ^target_commission_rate
request_body_param.desc: The desired commission rate for the target collaboration. The desired commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `100`.

request_body_param.name: ^shop_ads_commission_rate
request_body_param.desc:
The commission rate applies only to orders generated from ads. If a creator’s video is used as an ad without this rate being set, the resulting orders will instead earn either:
- The Shop Ads commission you configured in open collaboration, or
- The standard commission defined in this invitation.
The commission rate is specified in increments of 1/10,000.
For example, 1000 stands for 0.1 or 10%.

- "ALL""", it means regardless of whether the creator adds the product to the Showcase.

request_body_param.desc:

You can query based on:
- PRODUCT_ID：If you use PRODUCT_ID  to search, you can search for target collaboration information for a specified product ID.
- PRODUCT_NAME: If you use PRODUCT_NAME to search, you can fuzzy search for target collaboration information involving related product names.
- TARGET_COLLABORATION_ID: if you use Target_Collaboration_ID to search, you can search for target collaboration information for a specified target collaboration ID.
- TARGET_COLLABORATION_NAME: If you use Target_Collaboration_NAME to search, you can fuzzy search for target collaboration information involving related target collaboration names.

request_body_param.name: collaboration_status
request_body_param.desc:
Filtering by target collaborations' status.
You can query based on:
- ONGOING: If you use ONGOING to search, the remaining validity period of the returned target collaborations will be greater than 7 days.
- EXPIRING: If you use EXPIRING to search, the remaining validity period of the returned target collaborations will be less than 7 days.
- VALID: If you use VALID to search, all returned target collaborations will be valid.
- CANCELING: If you use CANCELING to search, all returned target collaborations will be in the process of canceling.
- COMPLETED: If you use COMPLETED to search, all returned target collaborations will be in the state of completed, including expired and canceled.

- SELLER_DEACTIVATE:  When the product is deactivated by the merchant, the SELLER_DEACTIVATE status is returned

request_body_param.name: status
request_body_param.desc:
The status of sample applications.
The possible enumerated values are:
- PENDING: The sample application is waiting for the seller's review.
- AWAITING_SHIPMENT: The application is approved, and the seller needs to ship the sample.
- SHIPPED: The sample has been shipped by the seller and is waiting for the creator to receive the package.
- CONTENT_PENDING: The creator has received the sample package and is expected to create content.
- REJECT_CANCELLED: The sample application has been rejected by the seller.
- OVERDUE_CANCELLED: The sample application has expired due to being overdue.
- UNFULFILL_CANCELLED: The creator did not fulfill the commitment to create content within the agreed timeframe.
- DEL_OPEN_COLLAB: Open collaboration has been deleted.
- SELLER_NOT_SHIP_CANCELLED: The seller did not ship the sample within the required timeframe.
- WITHDRAW_CANCELLED: The creator withdrew the sample application before the seller approved it.
- UNFULFILLABLE_CANCELLED: The application was cancelled due to reasons beyond the creator's control, making it impossible to create content.
- OPS_CANCELLED: The application was manually cancelled by operations staff.
- OPS_FAILED: The application was marked as failed by operations staff.
- OPS_COMPLETED: The application was manually marked as completed by operations staff.
- COMPLETED: The application is complete, and the creator has posted the content.
This field allows for tracking the status of a sample application throughout its lifecycle, providing visibility into each stage of the process for sellers and creators.

- PENDING: The creator is yet to fulfill the content creation obligation.
- ONGOING: Fulfillment is in progress; content has been created and is being evaluated against criteria.
- SUCCEED: Fulfillment has been successfully completed; the content meets the required standards.
- FAILED: Fulfillment failed; the content did not meet the required standards.
- OVERDUE: Fulfillment is overdue; the creator did not meet the deadline.
- SUSPEND: Fulfillment has been suspended.
- CANCELLED: Fulfillment has been cancelled, either by the creator or due to operational reasons.
- EXEMPTED: The creator has been exempted from the fulfillment obligation.

6a86ed7cbdb9cd047f292e48.env_desc: This API is used by Sellers to search for Creators in the Creator Marketplace. Sellers can search based on filters such as GMV, keywords, and Creator follower demographics. All the data returned is for the last 30 days.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

request_body_param.desc:
Caching search results improves api performance and ensures stable request results.
You don't need to pass a value on the first call. 
For the second call, please pass the value returned in the response of the first call.

request_body_param.desc: Searching creators by keyword, matching based on TikTok Username and Nickname.

request_body_param.desc: Filtering creators by follower demographics

request_body_param.name: ^age_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Follower age filtering options, which are range intervals, include: 
AGE_RANGE_18_24: "18-24", 
AGE_RANGE_25_34: "25-34", 
AGE_RANGE_35_44: "35-44", 
AGE_RANGE_45_54: "45-54", 
AGE_RANGE_55_AND_ABOVE: "55+"

request_body_param.name: ^count_range
request_body_param.desc: Follower count filtering

request_body_param.name: ^^count_ge
request_body_param.desc:
The minimum value of follower count. 
The value passed in must be greater than or equal to 0

request_body_param.name: ^^count_le
request_body_param.desc:
The maximum value of follower count. 
- Generally, a value greater than or equal to 0 needs to be passed. If a value less than 0 is passed, it means that the field will not be filtered.

request_body_param.desc: Filtering creators by follower gender which includes: "male", "female"

request_body_param.name: ^^gender
request_body_param.desc: A particular gender, "MALE" or "FEMALE"

request_body_param.name: ^^percentage_ge
request_body_param.desc:
Greater than or equal to a certain percentage, scaled up by 10,000 times. 
For example, 6000 stands for 0.6 or 60%

request_body_param.name: gmv_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Filtering by GMV range intervals which include: 
GMV_RANGE_0_100: "0-100", 
GMV_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
GMV_RANGE_1000_10000: "1000-10000", 
GMV_RANGE_10000_AND_ABOVE: "10000+"
For example: 
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 and GMV_RANGE_100_1000 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

request_body_param.name: units_sold_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Filtering by sales volume range intervals which include: 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10: "0-10", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100: "10-100", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_1000_AND_ABOVE: "1000+"
For example: 
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 10.
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 and UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.

request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return The partner identifier used in API requests. 
Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_body_param.name: file_name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the file to upload for this upload session.

request_body_param.name: file_type
request_body_param.desc: The type of file to upload. Currently, only video is supported.

request_body_param.name: file_size
request_body_param.desc: file size, bytes

request_body_param.name: total_chunk_count
request_body_param.desc: The total number of chunks.

request_body_param.name: target_path
request_body_param.desc: After the video is uploaded, use this interface to bind the video resource to the specific material

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^upload_url
response_param.desc: The URL provided by platform where the file can be uploaded.

response_param.name: ^upload_token
response_param.desc: The upload token used when uploading the file to the returned upload URL.
